profile.headline: Fullstack Software Engineer III | Current MBA student
profile.summary:
I'm Lisa I love learning, reading, running, yoga, rock climbing, sunshine, and the outdoors. Honestly I could keep going but I'll stop there. I've a dog and a fish, I make bread on the weekends and have found that I no longer like store bought bread😂

In the last year I've learned 2 things. 1 how important good people in my life are. We can't do life alone, so as I've surrounded myself with people who push me, make me laugh and understand me. The second, and most important, is I've started to learn the importance of loving and taking care of myself. I feel this is almost an abused subject on social media, but truly taking care of yourself through self love, therapy, diet and exercise, and listening to your inner self can't be understated. Be kind to yourself and others. Most of us have more than enough shit and not enough love. Be the light! 

I work as a software engineer at Myriad Genetics as a full stack developer. I was apart of the team that rebuilt the microfrontend ordering portal builtin React, Typescript, Python, GraphQL, Strawberry.

Before software engineering I spent my time as a web developer. These jobs used the CMS tool  WordPress. Most of the The job was to redesigning templates, create internal customs templates to meet SEO needs. And the most import part was redesigning websites using: PHP, Javascript, HTML, and CSS/SASS

In college I studied fine arts with an emphasis in graphic design. I double minored in business (because I'll always work for one, so I might as well understand how they operate) and art history. I was first introduced to programing when I had to take a college course where we built websites. After wanting to pluck, fry, then eat my own eyeballs, I realized I loved coding!

positions.title: Software Engineer Student
positions.description:
Remote full-time online software program teaching 3 full stack CRUD languages: MERN, JAVA, Python. Along with their accompanying technologies: HTML, CSS, JS, SQL, My SQL Workbench, Flask, Mongo/MonGoose, SpringBoot, Terminal, GIT,  Node

70-80hr study weeks, morning algorithms practice and mass networking with students from all over the country.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
Online marketing company focused on helping lawyers with their online and SEO presences. The developer task was to build fully functioning mobile responsive without losing any SEO rankings.  

* Fast and reliable developer, paired with excellent visual design skills earned me lead to the company's project lead. Working on  all large scale, time sensitive projects, and unique projects
* Research and designed working solutions to company problems by building a CAPTCHA for the company that would integrate with the currently technologies in place: Gravity Forms and WordPress to prevent email spam from client websites. 
* Able to collaborator and work on a team. Overnight clients rankings dropped due to a benchmark. Team collaborated and built a custom theme in WordPress to address these issues. Contributing ideas OOP, sliders, video popup, light boxes, flip boxes, SVGs, and scroll animations.
* Dedicated worker able to handle and work under pressure. As the new system was designed, all developers were pulled onto that projects leaving me in charge of all company and client day to day work. 
* Great communication and team building skills, was in charge of interns and new hire training
positions.insights: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), Front-End Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Rebuilt and redesigned eCommerce sites using the Miva CMS platform. With an emphasis in mobile responsive design, schema rich, and interactive designs. Also worked with clients on PrestaShop, Shopify, BigCommerence, Magento, and WooCommerece.  

* Mastered Miva language on the Job
* Frontend developer in charge of all the visual and responsive elements on the web page.

positions.description:

* Learned the work flow of real projects
* Allowed to sit in on client meetings

projects.title: Smugetor
projects.description:
Java project built with: #Java, #SpringBoot, #JS, #CSS, #HTML to track your budget! 

You can track your budget, update it, and see previous budgets. There's also the option if you have other budget you can copy the recurring expense from any previous month (so you don't have to input it all again)!

projects.title: Sibs
projects.description:
An address book to keep track of birthdays, phone numbers, home and mailing address in a family tree relationship. Meaning I can see all my family members one away from me: siblings, parents, spouse, kids, and step ect. Then I can click down into family members and see their relationships 1 away from them!

Built with: MERN, React, MonogoDB, Mongoose, HTML, CSS
